item.title: THE TEXAS CHAINSAW MASSACRE Producer Glen Powell Reveals Whether He's Open To Playing Leatherface
item.description: Twisters star Glen Powell is executive producing A24's upcoming reboot of The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, but would he be open to taking on the role of horror icon, Leatherface?

item.title: MERCY: Sci-Fi Thriller Starring Chris Pratt & Rebecca Ferguson Hits Digital After Tanking At The Box Office
item.description: After failing to recoup its $60 million production budget, Mercy is now available to purchase on Digital platforms just 25 days after arriving in theaters...

item.title: Chris Hemsworth Confirms Plans For Thor Beyond AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY: "We've Got Some [Unique] Ideas"
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday star Chris Hemsworth has confirmed his future as the MCU's God of Thunder, hinting at Marvel Studios' "unique" plans for the character in Thor 5.

item.title: TRANSFORMERS Star Shia LaBeouf Arrested After Allegedly "Terrorizing" New Orleans During Mardi Gras
item.description: Shia LaBeouf, who is best known for his role as Sam Witwicky in Michael Bay's Transformers movies, has been arrested following an alleged fight during New Orleans Mardi Gras celebrations.

item.title: THE LAST RONIN R-Rated Movie Gets A Positive Update From TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES Co-Creator
item.description: After seemingly being scrapped by Paramount, the live-action The Last Ronin movie gets a much-needed positive update from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles co-creator Kevin Eastman.

item.title: SCOOBY-DOO Live-Action Netflix Series Casts SCREAM 7 Star Mckenna Grace As Daphne
item.description: Jeepers! Netflix's live-action Scooby-Doo series has cast Scream 7 and Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire star Mckenna Grace as Mystery Inc.'s Daphne Blake...

item.title: Here's How DC Is Celebrating The 40th Anniversary Of THE DARK KNIGHT RETURNS In 2026
item.description: DC Comics has announced plans to celebrate the 40th anniversary of The Dark Knight Returns in 2026, and we have a full breakdown of what to expect, including new Frank Miller and Jim Lee artwork.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Star Jared Leto Donned Blue Body Suit As Skeletor; Will Have "Shakespearean" Voice
item.description: New details have been revealed about Jared Leto's portrayal of Skeletor in Masters of the Universe, including how much time he spent on set and the Oscar-winner's voice performance.
